articles.title: Cash App Now Supports Stablecoins, Despite Bitcoin Maxi Jack Dorsey's 'Gatekeeper' Gripes
articles.snippet: Cash App has begun supporting stablecoin transactions on networks including Ethereum and Solana, pushing past its Bitcoin-based roots.

articles.title: Robinhood Opens Platform to AI Agents for Stock Trading and Credit Card Spending
articles.snippet: Retail brokerage Robinhood now lets users delegate stock purchases and credit card transactions to third-party AI systems.

articles.title: Grand Theft Data: Threat Actors Weaponizing GTA 6 Hype, NordVPN Warns
articles.snippet: Cybercriminals are weaponizing the hype surrounding Grand Theft Auto 6, flooding the internet with GTA phishing traps and malware.
